title: Key Rotate
summary: Keeps old and new API keys valid during a rotation and shows which clients have switched, so cutting off the old key doesn't take production down.
description: Rotation panel that keeps old and new API keys valid until a stated time, shows which clients use the new key, flags rare jobs that won't call before the old key expires, and holds an immediate cut-off while the old key is in use unless it leaked.
catches: Clients still calling with the old key
Rare jobs whose next call lands after the old key expires
Immediate revoke while the old key is still in use
Leaked key: allows an immediate cut-off on purpose
limits: Only knows the clients and last-seen times you pass
Rhythm-based predictions assume jobs keep their schedule
The overlap window is enforced by your key service, not this UI
a11y: Panel labelled by its title; overlap options are native radio inputs with labels
Client status list and warnings are polite live regions with text, not only icons
A blocked revoke is announced with role=alert
server: Enforce key expiry and revocation in the key service, and log last-used times per key so the client list is real.
stops: Helps prevent a key rotation taking production down
